before.note: The odd scuff: on two steps in eight the swinging heel brushes the floor 80 ms before it lands, a short grainy drag of leather over grit. Not in the step group: it has its own timing. Running lifts the feet clear, so it goes.

before.label: Engine
before.hint: A parallel twin, a big loping V-twin, a screaming inline four or a thumping single.
